Class Method

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.gaia.processing.source.Method
public final class Method extends Object
A method, a constructor, or the compact constructor of a record. 
Method.newBuilder("max")
        .addModifiers(Modifier.PUBLIC, Modifier.STATIC)
        .returns(int.class)
        .addParameter(int.class, "a")
        .addParameter(int.class, "b")
        .addStatement("return a > b ? a : b")
        .build();

Methods are values: two methods written the same are equal.

    • overriding

      public static Method.Builder overriding(ExecutableElement method)
      Returns a builder of a method that overrides another one: the same name, type variables, return type, parameters and exceptions, annotated with @Override, and without abstract or default.
      Parameters:
      method - the method to override
      Returns:
      a new builder, to add the code to
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the method is private, static or final, a member of a final type, or not a method; or a type in its signature has no name, as TypeName.of(TypeMirror) names it

    • overriding

      public static Method.Builder overriding(ExecutableElement method, DeclaredType enclosing, Types types)
      Returns a builder of a method that overrides another one, as a member of a type: type variables of the type are replaced by its type arguments. For example, overriding Comparable.compareTo(T) in Comparable<String> gives compareTo(String).
      Parameters:
      method - the method to override
      enclosing - the type the method is a member of, such as Comparable<String>
      types - the type utilities of the processing environment
      Returns:
      a new builder, to add the code to
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the method is private, static or final, a member of a final type, or not a method; it is not a member of the type; or a type in its signature has no name, as TypeName.of(TypeMirror) names it
